spans.s:
√skand (skándati; caskánda; áskāntsīt;
skantsyáti; skanná; -skándya, -skádya
). intrans. dart, spring, spurt; drop,
be spilled; fall. [cf. σκάνδ-αλον, ‘trapstick’
(cf. Ger. Falle, ‘trap, pit-fall,’ w.
fallen, ‘fall’), and ‘stumbling-block’; Lat.
[]
scand-ere, ‘climb,’ de-scend-ere, ‘climb
down’; scāla, *scad-la, ‘ladder.’]

skandha-deśa, m. region of the
shoulder, i. e. shoulder.

skándhas, n. ramification; branches of
a tree, tree-top.
